run.scope: Smoke gate: clean install, first launch flow, core loop in/out, every main-menu button, console errors
run.summary: Gate passed: a clean install reaches the age gate in 3.5 s, the first launch flow (age gate, story, welcome, tutorial level) works, and all 10 main-menu buttons open something. One trivial issue: no favicon, so every load logs a 404.

coverage.notes: SM-01 boot 3548 ms; SM-02 first launch; SM-03 0 script errors; SM-04 Play / Pause > Exit; SM-05 10 menu buttons.

evidence.caption: First launch on a clean profile

findings.title: No favicon: every page load logs a 404 error in the console
steps: Open the game in a browser with the developer console open
findings.expected: The page declares an icon and the console stays clean
findings.actual: index.html has no <link rel="icon">; the browser requests /favicon.ico, gets 404 and logs 'Failed to load resource'. Seen on every boot in this run.

evidence.caption: 404 on /favicon.ico and no icon link in index.html

findings.suggested_fix: Add <link rel="icon" href="assets/sprites/bee.png"> (or a favicon.ico) to index.html. It also gives the browser tab an icon.
